verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms docs.smooth.sh/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of docs pages, and the docs themselves are mirrored as .md files (e.g. live-share.md, proxies.md) enabling agent-friendly consumption. One community comment notes the docs pages aren't fully token-efficient, a minor caveat. Missing for 10: independent verification that agents actually consume llms.txt effectively, and no evidence of additional agent-specific doc formats beyond the single llms.txt file.
